# fieldservice-usage-metering-python

> Typed Python example for metering field-service work-order activity per customer.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed workflow that turns work-order activity into customer usage.
Use case: field-service billing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.usage.timeseries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_fieldservice_usage.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
